Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to identify a critical ambiguity in the task. The film "Blind Corner" has multiple entries in film databases (e.g., a 1927 film, a 1964 film, etc.). By immediately assuming the 1964 film directed by Lance Comfort was the correct target without first verifying if there are other films with the same title that might have different directors, the Planner set the entire trajectory of the search based on a potentially incorrect assumption. This lack of disambiguation led to the retrieval of data for the wrong director (Lance Comfort) instead of the director of the specific "Blind Corner" intended by the user (which could be the 1927 film directed by someone else). The error was a failure to break down the task into a step of "disambiguation" before "data retrieval."
